answer: Our network resists Sybil attacks through topological cut verifications and game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. Suspect nodes in cluster juniper face random validator audits where any forged consensus trigger stake slashing. Because validator committees sample graph bottlenecks across clusters, an adversary cannot simply echo fake endorsements or withstand the gale of collateral penalties. Crossing sparse cuts imposes superlinear attacker cost scaling with identity count.
